title: UK Property Tribunal RRO Precedent Finder & Award Calculator Input

action.title: Operation Mode
action.description: Choose whether to run both the RRO Award & Mitigation Calculator + Precedent Search, or an individual operation.

query.title: Keyword / Case Reference / Borough Query
query.description: Search by case reference (e.g. LON/00AJ/HMG/2025/0666), London borough, city, street, or judicial reasoning.

region.title: UK Tribunal Region
region.description: Filter by First-tier Tribunal Property Chamber region (London, Southern, Midlands, Northern, Eastern, or all).

offence_type.title: Housing Act 2004 / 2016 Offence Category
offence_type.description: Filter by statutory RRO offence category.

party_role.title: Schedule Perspective (Landlord Defence vs Tenant Claim)
party_role.description: Select whether the generated Scott Schedule / Skeleton Argument is framed for Landlord s.44 Mitigation Defence or Tenant RRO Claim.

monthly_rent_gbp.title: Monthly Rent (£ GBP)
monthly_rent_gbp.description: Gross monthly rent paid in the relevant period (£ GBP).

months_unlicensed.title: Months Unlicensed / Claimed (1–24 Months under Renters' Rights Act 2026)
months_unlicensed.description: Number of months of rent claimed (1 to 24 months under the Renters' Rights Act 2026 cap).

universal_credit_housing_gbp.title: Monthly Universal Credit / Housing Benefit Element (£ GBP)
universal_credit_housing_gbp.description: Monthly Universal Credit housing element deducted from tenant-recoverable rent under s.44(3).

utilities_included_monthly_gbp.title: Monthly Utilities / Council Tax Included in Rent (£ GBP)
utilities_included_monthly_gbp.description: Monthly gas, electricity, water, broadband, or council tax paid by landlord and deductible under Acheampong / Vadamalayan.

mitigation_factors.title: Section 44 Conduct & Mitigation Factors (Comma-Separated)
mitigation_factors.description: Comma-separated s.44 mitigation/conduct tags: utilities_deducted, good_condition, first_offence, letting_agent_reliance, financial_hardship, delayed_council_application, tenant_conduct, professional_landlord_aggravation, director_liability.

claim_text.title: Optional Private Claim / Statement of Case Text (Stateless Zero-Retention Audit)
claim_text.description: Optional draft claim text for stateless ephemeral exposure auditing (wiped in finally: block).

limit.title: Maximum Precedents Returned
limit.description: Maximum number of matched GOV.UK RRO tribunal rulings to return (1..100).
